name: Blick Winkel
source:
A metafictional entity that provides a bird's-eye view of the events of the game world without being tied to a timeline, almost like the player himself. Several characters communicate with the BW and, by borrowing its perspective, are capable of timeless perception. Coco is the representative of the group, often making cryptic statements because she knows the future.

It can travel through the three spacial dimensions and the time dimension, [spoiler]he overlaps his consciousness with Hokuto and is the real mastermind behind the "accident" of 2034.[/spoiler]
